[SWS_EM_01310] Get Activation Time
⌈
Execution Management shall provide
an API DeterministicClient::GetActivationTime which provides a deter-
ministic timestamp that represents the point in time when the current kRun cy-
cle was activated by DeterministicClient::WaitForNextActivation (see [SWS_EM_01301]). Deterministic means, that the timestamps are identical for Pro-
cesses which are executed redundantly. Subsequent calls within a cycle shall always
return the same value.
⌋
